trait.name: Mana Reserves
trait.text: Unspent Mana is not lost: it is kept as Reserves, up to your Max Reserves (3). Cards spend your Mana before your Reserves. Start each fight with 1 Reserve. trait.name: The Totem Cycle
trait.text: You start with a Hawk and a Bear totem, in that order. Each does something every turn while it stands. A command makes your front totem act and consumes it; planting into a full row pushes the front one out, and it acts as it goes. Spirit never goes down: each point adds 1 to every totem number (not the Elder Tree or the Moon Owl). Spiritwalker: The first time a totem acts each turn on your order or as it leaves the row, draw 1 card and gain 4 Barrier.
